title.zh: 清点全站的有效温度读数
title.en: Count the Station's Valid Temperature Readings

brief.zh: 确认清洗后有多少条温度记录可以用来分析。
brief.en: Check how many temperature readings remain available for analysis after cleaning.

concept.zh: 样本数数的是记录的条数。
concept.en: The sample count tells you how many readings you have.

hints.zh: 保持所有区域，挑一个回答“有多少条”的统计量。
hints.en: Keep all areas and choose the statistic that answers “how many readings?”

prompt.zh: 输出全站清洗后的样本数。
prompt.en: Return the station-wide count after cleaning.
